scripts.build: npm run build -w @factory/shared && npm run build -w @factory/database && npm run build -w @factory/discovery && npm run build -w @factory/worker && npm run build -w @factory/discord-gateway && npm run build -w @factory/api && npm run build -w @factory/dashboard
scripts.cloudflare:build: npm run build -w @factory/shared && npm run build -w @factory/database && npm run build -w @factory/dashboard
